# Principal Software Engineer — Disney (Cruise Line Shipboard Systems)

---

**Job ID:** 10153541
**Date Posted:** 2026-07-07
**Date Applied:** Aug 1, 2026
**Salary Range:** $175,500 – $235,400 / year (Orlando, FL hiring range)

---

## Job Summary

Disney Experiences (Technology & Digital) role reporting to the Director of Software Engineering – Fleetwide Shipboard Solutions, within the Disney Cruise Line organization. The role is responsible for modernizing a diverse portfolio of bespoke/aging shipboard systems (financials, operational logistics, guest-facing interactives, crew support) into a unified, modern engineering ecosystem, with a strong AI-tooling-in-the-SDLC mandate. Primarily on-site, Celebration, FL, occasionally from home.

---

## What You'll Do

- Own analysis, design, programming, debugging, and modification of software across local/networked/cloud systems; lead projects on large or highly sophisticated software programs.
- Drive reference-architecture standards across shipboard solutions; lead the replacement/modernization strategy for aging bespoke systems.
- Define and integrate AI tooling into the engineering SDLC, establishing best practices and skill-development pathways.
- Exercise full autonomy engaging diverse teams to define requirements; lead estimation/planning for scalable projects.

### Required Qualifications
- Minimum 10 years of related work experience
- Excellent communication/leadership; a visionary who motivates teams
- Authority in Flutter, Mobile Native (iOS/Android), Java, Angular, Node.js, RESTful API design, on-premise infrastructure management, data-standardization principles, and microservices architecture

Preferred: cruise/hospitality/travel or shipboard/remote operational environment experience, legacy-to-modern migration leadership, Docker/Kubernetes on-prem, cybersecurity/data-privacy for guest data, real-time data sync in intermittent connectivity, practical AI/ML tooling for SDLC.

### Education
Bachelor's degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or comparable — and/or equivalent work experience. Preferred: Master's degree; relevant architecture/cloud/AI-ML certifications.

### Benefits
Disney's standard rewards package: health/savings benefits, educational opportunities, bonus and/or long-term incentive units depending on level, full medical/financial benefits.

---

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Aug 1, 2026

- **Some overlap:** hands-on on-premise infrastructure experience (Kubernetes-hosted, self-developed ERP/CRM with dynamic BOM generation; internal IT infrastructure oversight) and product-modernization leadership (converting legacy servo-driven platforms to a standardized linear-motor architecture) both speak to the "modernize aging systems" theme of this role, even outside a software-product context.
- **Significant gap:** the core required stack — Flutter, mobile native iOS/Android, Java, Angular, Node.js, RESTful API design, microservices architecture — has no direct evidence in the record. My software work is LabVIEW-based automation, Python/MATLAB scripting, and infrastructure/ERP development, not a professional multi-stack web/mobile software engineering background.
- **Gap:** 10 years "related work experience" required vs. roughly 5 years of professional engineering experience at the time of application, and that experience isn't specifically in software engineering.
- This looks like a reach application driven by title similarity ("Principal Software Engineer" closely mirrors resume framing used elsewhere) rather than a close skills match, and the tracker shows it moved to "No longer in consideration" on Aug 4, 2026 — consistent with the qualifications gap above.

### Now — Aug 22, 2026

No material change — none of Flutter, Java, Angular, Node.js, or microservices experience has been added to the record since application, and this application is already closed.

---

## About the Company

This role sits within Disney Entertainment (DX)'s Technology & Digital organization, specifically Disney Cruise Line, building the digital and physical guest experience across Disney's Parks & Resorts, Cruise Line, Aulani, and Disney Vacation Club brands.
